blk_part_01_part_1_who_iron_man_is.text: Tony does not have magic. He does not come from space. His power is his powered armor suit. This suit is a strong metal body that he wears. It lets him fly, and it protects him. In the comics, the armor is red and gold. So when we talk about Iron Man, we really talk about two things at the same time: the smart man inside, and the suit he made.

So four people worked together, and each one added one piece.

blk_part_04_part_4_how_the_2008_film_was.text: The film follows the same problem, invention, result idea from the comics. Tony is captured, he builds a suit, and he becomes a hero. To show the suit on screen, the team used two ways together. Actors wore real armor costumes for some scenes. For other scenes, the suit was made with computer effects, called CGI. A company named Industrial Light and Magic did much of this work. Real parts and computer parts were mixed, so the armor looked heavy and real.
